T: From New York back to the bush.
D: Mick takes Sue home to the Top End while drug dealers chase them.
P: Serve the mains when Mick sets up his bush ambush.
S: Mick's camp in the Top End
450g self-raising flour, salt, 60g rubbed-in butter and milk to a soft dough, shaped and baked at 200C for 30 minutes (or in a camp oven in the coals). Butter and golden syrup.
Wally minding the pub while Mick's in New York

Thick beef sausages grilled slowly, rolled in white bread with fried onions and tomato sauce. Grill 8 thick beef sausages slowly over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often. Fry 2 sliced onions until soft and golden. Wrap each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.
Kakadu plum or green mango diced with chilli, lime, red onion and coriander, corn chips or grilled flatbread.
Kakadu plum powder or green mango@Produce
M: Mick's fishing method, even in New York harbour

Whole barramundi stuffed with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in foil (or paperbark) and cooked over coals for 20 minutes. Stuff a 1.5kg whole barramundi with lemon slices, a sliced knob of ginger and a bunch of coriander. Dot with 50g butter and wrap well in foil. Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning once.
Rump seared hard and rested, sliced, on toasted Turkish with caramelised onion, melted cheddar, beetroot and barbecue sauce.
W: 4 whites whipped with 220g caster sugar, cornflour and vinegar, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, cream, passionfruit and mango.
K: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic
back in Mick's Top End country after the ambush

Gin over ice with tonic, a lemon myrtle sugar rim and fresh lime, sharp and cold for a hot night in the bush. Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with 1 tsp ground lemon myrtle on a plate. Run lime around 4 glass rims and dip. Fill with ice, add 45ml gin and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml tonic water. Add a lime wheel.

edition.tagline: From New York back to the bush.

s.note: Warm damper with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Mix in about 300ml milk to a soft dough, shape into a round and score a cross. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve warm with butter and golden syrup.

s.note: Thick beef sausages grilled slowly, rolled in white bread with fried onions and tomato sauce.
s.how: Grill 8 thick beef sausages slowly over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often. Fry 2 sliced onions until soft and golden. Wrap each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.

m.note: Whole barramundi stuffed with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in foil (or paperbark) and cooked over coals for 20 minutes.
m.how: Stuff a 1.5kg whole barramundi with lemon slices, a sliced knob of ginger and a bunch of coriander. Dot with 50g butter and wrap well in foil. Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning once.

w.note: Crisp-shelled pavlova with cream, passionfruit and mango
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 4 passionfruit and a sliced mango.

d.n: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic
d.note: Gin over ice with tonic, a lemon myrtle sugar rim and fresh lime, sharp and cold for a hot night in the bush.
d.how: Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with 1 tsp ground lemon myrtle on a plate. Run lime around 4 glass rims and dip. Fill with ice, add 45ml gin and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml tonic water. Add a lime wheel.
